en.headline: Lawmakers question HK$27 billion funding request for San Tin Technopole works
en.dek: The Development Bureau seeks approval for site formation, a wetland park and an effluent plant as part of the second stage of the border tech hub.
body: Hong Kong lawmakers raised concerns about costs and timelines during a Legislative Council panel discussion on Tuesday as the government outlined a request for about HK$27.2 billion to fund the second stage of works at the San Tin Technopole.

The proposal covers forming about 175 hectares of land, establishing more than one-third of the Sam Po Shue Wetland Conservation Park, and building an effluent polishing plant. Officials said the first batch of innovation and technology land could become available from the 2028/29 financial year.

Members asked about measures to control cost overruns. Civil Engineering and Development Department officials explained that under the target price contract arrangement, the government would share only up to 105 per cent of the target price, with the contractor bearing the rest. The Permanent Secretary for Development noted that early land availability would help attract investment and recover funds more quickly.

The funding request follows an earlier HK$27.3 billion approved in late 2024 for the first stage. Separate proposals for a HK$10 billion capital injection into the dedicated San Tin Technopole company remain under consideration by the Finance Committee.

zh.headline: 議員關注新田科技城第二階段約272億元撥款申請
zh.dek: 發展局向立法會申請撥款，涵蓋土地平整、三寶樹濕地保育公園及淨水設施，作為科技城第二階段工程。
body: 政府周二在立法會發展事務委員會會議上，就新田科技城第二階段工程申請近272億元撥款，議員關注工程成本控制及時程。
建議涵蓋約175公頃土地平整、建立三寶樹濕地保育公園超過三分之一部分，以及建造新田淨水設施。官員表示，首批創科用地可於2028/29年度起陸續產出。
有議員詢問如何預防超支。土木工程拓展署解釋，採用目標價格合約模式，政府只分擔目標價格的105%，超出部分由承建商負擔。發展局常任秘書長指出，提早提供土地有助招商引資及加快資金回籠。
是次撥款申請繼2024年底已獲批的273億元第一階段工程之後提出。另外，向新田科技城公司注入100億元起始資金的建議，仍待財務委員會審議。
